long_biography.plain_text:
Il Barone Rampante, the racing team founded by restaurateur Giuseppe Cipriani, took its name from Italo Calvino's novel. Cipriani established it in 1991 after competing on American circuits and in Italian Formula 3. The team entered international Formula 3000, where Alessandro Zanardi finished runner-up in its debut season. Rubens Barrichello and Andrea Montermini also drove for the outfit.

Cipriani's involvement extended beyond team ownership to sustained competition behind the wheel. He raced single-seaters before moving into GT cars, and his team developed a Lamborghini programme. In 2024 he won the amateur class of the International GT Open.

Cipriani's involvement extended beyond team ownership to sustained competition behind the wheel. He raced single-seaters before moving into GT cars, and his team developed a Lamborghini programme. In 2024 he won the amateur class of the International GT Open.
